embedding_model.finding: The supplied DeepMind Gemini Embedding page describes Gemini Embedding 2, an API-served proprietary Google model. It contains no Hugging Face/download link. The separately documented downloadable open-weight recommendation is EmbeddingGemma 2.

gemini_embedding_2.weights_identity: Gemini weights; API access only, not the Hugging Face download.

downloadable_open_alternative.model_family: EmbeddingGemma 2 / Gemma 4-derived open multimodal embedding model
downloadable_open_alternative.identity_note: Built by Google DeepMind and informed by Gemma/Gemini research, but the weights are EmbeddingGemma/Gemma-family weights, not Gemini Embedding 2 weights.
downloadable_open_alternative.precision_note: Use bfloat16 or float32; the model card warns not to use float16.
downloadable_open_alternative.local_text_only_option: Disable vision_config and audio_config when loading to use only the 270M text portion.

legacy_alternative.note: Previous text-only EmbeddingGemma 1; do not confuse it with current EmbeddingGemma 2 or API-only Gemini Embedding 2.

blockers_uncertainties: The supplied /show/ result is dynamic and may change. This snapshot contains 80 items and preserves the observed order.
Four playlist videos have no defensible repository folder mapping: 8wQBvT6L8Xk, SHxRxkjkP80, rQm-kX4ePt8, Z9nwmtHUggY. They are left null rather than fabricated.
sqJrl09dDmI is inferred to share 2025-07-22-multimodality with sCScFZB4Am8 because it is titled Part 1; repository metadata directly identifies only sCScFZB4Am8.
mm6n4n09RaU is inferred as repository episode 59 by title; its repository metadata has no YouTube watch ID.
Repository metadata links episode 76 to bGMiRmXbRUs, but that video was not returned by the supplied show URL snapshot.

Repository README/data include known inconsistencies (for example episode 61 README code link points to the agent-observability directory); mappings here prioritize per-folder meta.md/data.json and exact YouTube IDs.

All 80 videos enumerated generated English caption tracks. A bulk content-fetch verification retrieved 43 successfully before YouTube blocked further requests from this IP; the remaining 37 are caption-present but require retry/backoff or another allowed egress path. Automatic captions can contain errors.

The exact supplied DeepMind page does not itself link to Hugging Face. EmbeddingGemma 2 is identified through Google’s separate official EmbeddingGemma documentation, which links the official Hugging Face collection.
